text:
ivy: FYI found a reproducible case where console impersonation ignores the selected project and charges the SA owner org instead. Quick repro in thread.
ivy: Repro: Console -> Try API -> Impersonate SA sa-reports@acme -> pick project=proj-reports -> send -> quota shows on org-acme.
ivy: Ingress headers captured: `X-Impersonate: sa-reports; X-Console-Project: proj-reports; Authorization: Bearer ...`
ram: Router log: `[2026-04-10T11:02:01Z] req=req_0x7c claims={"sa":"sa-reports","project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=effective_project_missing`
ram: Looks like the console header is getting dropped in the proxy for impersonation flows. We've tightened header allowlist recently.
sophia: Can reproduce locally. Two fixes: 1) preserve X-Console-Project through proxy for impersonation route (fast), 2) mint tokens with `effective_project` claim at keygen time (long-term). Prefer 2 for security.
ivy: For visibility, can we add a telemetry tag on quota events `billing_source=token_claim|header|sa_owner`? Need to quantify how many hits this affects.
billing: Absolutely. If this hit customers we need a detection query: requests with impersonation where billing_source=sa_owner in the last 7 days. We'll need sample request ids for refunds.
ops-bot: rollout: proxy v2.19 canary scheduled 23:00 PDT. Add feature flag `authz:preserve-console-project` for quick toggle.
ram: Plan: 1) quick PR to proxy to whitelist X-Console-Project for impersonation routes (hotfix); 2) keygen PR to validate project membership and embed `effective_project` claim in ephemeral tokens; 3) router PR to add telemetry `billing_source`. Gate 2 & 3 behind `authz:embed-project-claim`.
sophia: Also console UX: show inline banner when impersonating a SA with no default project: "Requests may be billed to org-acme unless you set a project for this SA". Small change reduces support noise.
ivy: Also please add an internal-only header `X-Force-Project` for SRE testing. Make it no-op in prod unless `authz:force-project-debug` flag is enabled.
ram: Security note: when embedding project claim, enforce caller is a member of that project and log audit entry `minted_token -> user -> project`.
billing: Once telemetry lands, run the detection and we'll scope credits. Also update #support with repro steps.
ops-bot: reminder: include rollback playbook in PRs and tag #billing #support in rollout ticket.
sophia: I'll open PRs for proxy and router telemetry now. ETA for reviews: 2-3 hours. Ivy, can you draft the console banner copy?
ivy: Drafting now, will paste here in 15m. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:
